title: Morgan Gibbs-White set for Nottingham Forest return ahead of England audition
content:
Morgan Gibbs-White could return to face Manchester United at Old Trafford on Sunday — and stage a fresh audition for a place at this summer’s World Cup.

The 26-year-old Nottingham Forest midfielder will be included in Thomas Tuchel’s 55-man long-list squad for the tournament, which will be announced next Friday, and will hope to get the chance to impress again, having returned to training following the facial injury he sustained in the 3-1 win at Chelsea on May 4.

Gibbs-White, who is among eight nominees for the Premier League Player of the Season award, has trained with a specially-made mask, which he would wear if he does feature in Manchester on Sunday.

“He started to work with the team today. Let’s see,” said head coach Vitor Pereira in his pre-match press conference.

“It is strange when you use the mask. But I spoke with him and he said he was okay. We will see if he is ready and in condition.”

“He deserves everything. He is a top player and he deserves everything life and football gives to him,” said Pereira, when asked about Gibbs-White’s league nomination. “He’s a fighter. He has a lot of talent. He is a leader.”

Gibbs-White has scored 16 goals this season but has hit form in particular in recent weeks, registering nine goal involvements in his last eight Premier League appearances, including seven goals and two assists.

He scored a hat-trick in the 4-1 win over Burnley in April and scored again in the 5-0 win at Sunderland, which helped lead Forest to safety.

Gibbs-White has earned six England caps but the last of those came when he had a 20-minute cameo off the bench in the 3-0 friendly win over Wales, in October. He faces some serious competition for his international place in his position, alongside the likes of Cole Palmer, Jude Bellingham, Phil Foden and Morgan Rogers.

Forest also hope to have Dan Ndoye and Ibrahim Sangare available to face United, but they will be without Murillo and Ola Aina. Ndoye has already returned to training and Sangare is expected to work with the rest of the squad tomorrow.
